newsitem.title: UK: LINTAS LAUNCHES TUBORG CAMPAIGN IN HUNGARY.
newsitem.headline: LINTAS LAUNCHES TUBORG CAMPAIGN IN HUNGARY.

text.p: Advertising agency Ammirati Puris Lintas Budapest said on Tuesday its campaign to launch Danish beer Tuborg in Hungary will target an upmarket audience, carrying the theme "Tuborg surpasses everything".
Ammirati Puris Lintas Budapest, part of the Ammirati Puris Lintas (APL) network which is owned by Interpublic Group of Cos Inc, released a statement in London launching the campaign.

"It was imperative that the campaign not only reflects Tuborg's uniqueness and top-quality positioning, it closely reflects the yuppie target audience's distinctive values and perceptions of themselves," said Agnes Weninger, deputy managing director of APL Budapest.
"We found the most important thing for them was to not be part of the crowd."

The television campaign shows the "real" story behind how historical figures became great. The adverts describe how Tuborg helped the shy, self-conscious and anonymous Casanova become the great womanizer and how the harassed Alexander Graham Bell, fed up with his mother-in-law, invented the telephone.
The campaigns highlight ordinary situations that cannot be changed, but which -- with the help of a Tuborg -- can be handled calmly.

The situations include: "Your boss is back from holiday on Monday," "When the border guard notices your passport has expired," and "When you have to watch your guests instead of the soccer World Cup."
Dreher Breweries distributes Tuborg in Hungary.
